enemies: Imps (level 2) if you plan on collecting the beads yourself

st.t: Collect one of each bead. You can kill imps for these beads, or buy them on the Grand Exchange.
Head to the Wizards' Tower, south of Draynor Village, and climb the staircase to the top floor with the required beads, choosing Up on the way.
Talk to Wizard Mizgog with the required beads to finish the quest.
